subject: Outside reading of Appendix A (Conformance Tests, M1-M35, AP1) of draft-nestorov-scitt-p10-underdetermination-02
boundary: A reading of what the public text lets an outside reader reconstruct, not a conformance claim. Read: the draft, README files, profile/specification/prereg text, manifests, published vectors and pin files of the three repositories at the Appendix C.1 pins, and, from ../s2b, the frozen S2b prereg r7 section 15.2 grammar and the pass-2 report of ../. Not opened: .lean modules, src/, tests/, scripts/, harness/, generators, issues, git history. Some file names under tests/ were seen in a directory listing; none was opened.
pins: PINS.txt: the three repositories at the commits and tag objects of Appendix C.1 (A01/A02, A04/A05, A07/A08); file digests A03, A06, A09, A10, A11 recomputed and equal; the 315 vectors/ files listed in VectorManifestS2aV0.json all hash to their listed values and no file under vectors/ is unlisted.

classes.a: covered by the S2b reading of ../ (pass 2, out/report-pass2.json), S2b case ids named, all agree; nothing re-run here
classes.b: reconstructible from the public text and vectors, and run here (out/checks-b.json, out/s2a-coverage.json)
classes.c: reconstructible from the public text, not run here
classes.d: not reconstructible from the text alone, or needs the implementation or a Lean run

class_rule: One class per test. A test with a check run in this pass is (b) even if the S2b reading also covers part of it (named in s2b_cases). 'partial': true means the check run covers only part of the mutation as worded.

results.s1_vectors: 15 of 15 agree (P1 accepted; 14 negatives rejected, each for the reason TEST_VECTORS.md gives)
results.s1_toy_m2: agree: with Compatible := true, FUC is false for both toy claims; FUC is true for secondBit on the reconstructed profile
results.s1_statement: claim, evidence, w0, w1 digests (JCS) equal TEST_VECTORS.md and p1.statement.json; instance SHA-256 equal; limitations_digest reproduced as SHA-256 of the JCS of the limitations array; a one-word change of a limitation text changes it; AP1 and COVERAGE_INSTANCE texts are verbatim substrings of the profile; must-understand rule rejects the predicate without limitations; the statement records SHA-256(VerifierManifestS1.json) (A06)
results.s2a_pB_strict: 72 of 72 agree at the pB level (N22a-c c1_profileFields, N23a-c c1_profileDecode, N20 manifest digest differs; the other 65 pass)
results.s2a_preclosure_k: 7 of 7 (S2-K1-K7 PreclosureDigestV0 digests recomputed with RFC 8785)
results.s2a_coverage: 71 transcripts decoded strictly from the S2b prereg 15.2 grammar; 72 of 72 vectors (71 with a transcript, plus N7b without one) give the expected outcome and the exact reason code; TB7 72 of 72 (N20 REJECT, N21 HALT); the section 9 claim-digest binding fails for N33 only, as the vector expects

numbering_note: Appendix A M1-M35 and AP1 carry the same numbers and expected outcomes as profile v0.1.1 section 7.1/7.2 (SHA-256 b92c0d68..., A03). The draft renames 'receipt' to 'P10 Adjudication Statement', 'Receipt' to 'SCITT Receipt' and 'section 2.4' to 'Section 5'; M35 keeps a lowercase 'receipt'. The S1 and S2a documents cite the profile's numbers.

I-8 order (contiguity, row/detail correspondence, log identity, profile digest, pB decode and fields), then C1a, C1b, C1c; each vector carries one fault, so the order is not separated by the vectors. The row/detail mismatch code is this reading's name, no vector exercises it
a valid profile commitment is owner-signed and verified, whatever its digest; a wrong digest is then c3_profileDigestMismatch (G6-B1, N36c), superseding I-6, where validity included the digest
I-5: entries strictly before the closure leaf that are owner-signed verified lifecycle entries (earlier closure attempts included) or RelevantAdmissions, in leaf order
I-3: a valid owner adjudication whose reference names a non-admission entry signed by another iss; the closure's refs fall under C8
